# Photographic elm twig

ElmTwig_Designed.png is project artwork generated with the built-in imagegen tool on October 20, 2026. Transparent alpha is retained; the original remains at C:/Users/MOBPC/.codex/generated_images/01a12e1c-36f0-77a1-b81d-58902ccda50b/exec-a7757ea0-172e-414b-9b38-48b8c8d11ea0.png.

Used on small branch sprays in PresentationRepairs.NaturalTrees, with an alpha-tested, physically lit foliage shader and restrained wind. Desktop 2048 max; Android 1024 ASTC; mip coverage retained. No emission or baked highlights.

Exact prompt:

Use case: game-texture. A single photorealistic cutout of one delicate deciduous elm twig with 9 to 13 small green oval serrated leaves, natural branching stems, real fine veins, slightly varied muted olive and fresh green hues, some leaf undersides, believable botanical anatomy. Flat diffuse neutral illumination, no directional highlights, no cast shadow, no ambient background, fully transparent background. Twig occupies most of the square canvas with generous clear edge padding, isolated single coherent spray, not a tree, not a collage or atlas or repeated tiling pattern. Intended as a realistic small tree foliage card albedo/alpha for a physically lit night street in a VR game; photograph-like material, no illustration, no text or logo, no baked glow.
